how_to_use: Pick ideas so a batch follows the anti-repeat rules in README.md. Mark an idea used by setting used to the episode id. Add new ideas from each week's research. Never copy another channel's exact scenario; change the threat, setting and twist.

interactive_protect.what: Command text at second 0 ('Protect Nugget from …!'), danger approaching, finger target on screen, viewer's hand shields Nugget, funny twist ending.

ideas.idea: Protect Nugget from the cucumber (cats' famous fear)
ideas.twist: Nugget hides behind the hand, then the cucumber turns out to be a pickle and Nugget eats it

ideas.idea: Protect Nugget from the vacuum cleaner
ideas.twist: hand switches it off; Nugget puts on sunglasses and rides it ('NEW RIDE UNLOCKED')

ideas.idea: Protect Nugget from bath time (water drops)
ideas.twist: Nugget dry and smug, then a single drop lands on his nose

ideas.idea: Protect Nugget's food from the dog's paw
ideas.twist: dog was only bringing Nugget a bonus treat

ideas.idea: Protect Nugget from the laser dot
ideas.twist: hand blocks it, laser lands on the hand, Nugget attacks the hand

ideas.idea: Protect Nugget from the falling leaves (autumn)
ideas.twist: he jumps into the leaf pile and disappears

ideas.idea: Protect Nugget's fish treat from the seagull
ideas.twist: the seagull was bringing a second treat

ideas.idea: Protect Nugget from the bath tub
ideas.twist: he comes out fluffy like a cloud and loves it

interactive_play.what: Finger is a toy or helper: 'Put your finger here to pet Nugget / give Nugget a high five / help Nugget reach the shelf'.

ideas.idea: Put your finger here to pet Nugget
ideas.twist: Nugget purrs louder and louder until he floats

ideas.idea: Hold your finger here so Nugget can climb to the cookie jar
ideas.twist: Nugget gets the cookie, gives the viewer half

ideas.idea: Tap to wake Nugget up for breakfast
ideas.twist: he only wakes when the food bag rustles

relatable_owner.what: Everyday cat-owner moment, title speaks to owners. 11–24 s, upbeat music, no dialogue.

ideas.idea: 3 AM zoomies
Knocking the cup off the table while staring at you
ideas.title_hint: He looked me in the eyes the whole time
ideas.note: mug push used inside 3am-zoomies; do not make a separate cup video soon

ideas.idea: Sitting on the laptop during a work call
ideas.title_hint: Every remote worker with a cat

ideas.idea: Ignoring the expensive bed, loving the box it came in
Screaming for food when the bowl is only half empty
ideas.title_hint: The bowl is NOT empty, Nugget

ideas.idea: Owner opens a can of tuna: Nugget teleports
Nugget sits exactly on the one paper you need
ideas.title_hint: Of all the places in the house…

reaction.what: Nugget meets one thing and overreacts. Strong first-second visual, punch zoom, big one-word text.

ideas.idea: Nugget bites a lemon
Nugget sees himself in the mirror for the first time
Nugget tastes chili (spicy fire breath)
Nugget hears the treat bag from 3 rooms away

mini_story.what: Silent 3-beat story with a clear setup, problem and payoff, ending on a loop back to the start.

ideas.idea: Nugget tries to catch the fish in a TV nature show
Nugget vs the automatic door
